hardware: v4-32; four hosts, 120 CPUs and 256GB host RAM each
limits: No queue, task or wrapper wallclock limit; Iris preemption defaults
objective: FP32 block Hessian of next-token cross entropy plus z-loss 1e-7; weight decay excluded
scope: Middle pilot, then early/late conditional on valid derivatives and data; no training or fresh-Gram followup
data_weighting: Equal groups; within each group native valid-weight-normalized mean, retain counts and sample hashes
retention: TPU-only job; no GPU allocations requested or modified
